instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make an invitation file that any mail client turns into a calendar event, or into a cancellation", and give it uid (The event's own id; keep it for updates and the cancel); start (Start instant); end (End instant); summary; organizer.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:make-a-calendar-invite and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Writes a standard calendar file (.ics): a request that creates or updates an event, or a cancel that removes it.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: booking (records:list, records:read, records:write); booking-book (records:read, records:write).
